'''Erhard Geißler''' (born 17 December 1930 in [[Leipzig]], [[Germany]])<ref>{{Cite web|date=2011-01-03|title=Prof. Erhard Geißler wird 75 – Genetiker und Abrüstungsexperte|url=https://www.mdc-berlin.de/de/news/2005/20051216-prof__erhard_gei_ler_wird_75___genetiker_u/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110103082051/http://www.mdc-berlin.de/de/news/2005/20051216-prof__erhard_gei_ler_wird_75___genetiker_u/index.html|archive-date=3 January 2011}}</ref> is a German [[biologist]] and [[geneticist]].

== Biography ==
Geißler achieved his ''Abitur'' in 1950 and then began studying biology at [[Leipzig University]], becoming an intern for the Institute for Medicine and Biology at the Berlin-Buch campus in 1953.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=Berg|first=Lilo|title="How fortunate I was": Erhard Geißler turns 90|url=https://www.mdc-berlin.de/news/news/how-fortunate-i-was-erhard-geissler-turns-90|access-date=2021-12-15|website=www.mdc-berlin.de|language=en}}</ref> He was a professor for [[genetics]] at the [[University of Rostock]], reaching full professor rank in 1965.<ref name=":0" /> Between 1965 and 1971 he was [[Dean (education)|dean]] of the university.{{Citation needed|date=December 2021}} Subsequently, he was head of the [[bioethics]] research group at the [[Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association|Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine]], from 1992 until his retirement in 2000.<ref name=":0" /> The [[Stockholm International Peace Research Institute]] hired him in 1983 as a [[Biological agent|biological weapons]] consultant.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bioethik-diskurs.de/documents/English_version/Home/Team/ |title=Bioethik Diskurs |publisher=SET-DEV |accessdate=16 March 2010 }}{{dead link|date=December 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref name=":0" />

Early in his career, he was a freelancer for ''[[Leipziger Volkszeitung]]''. His daughter is now a journalist.<ref name=":0" />

== Selected publications ==
* ''Biological and Toxin Weapons Today.'' Oxford 1986
* ''Strengthening the Biological Weapons Convention by Confidence-Building Measures.'' Oxford 1990
* ''Prevention of a Biological and Toxin Arms Race and the Responsibility of Scientists.'' Berlin 1991 (Co-author)
* ''Control of Dual-Threat Agents: The Vaccines for Peace Programme.'' Oxford 1994
* ''Hitler und die Biowaffen.'' Münster 1998<ref>{{Cite book|last=Erhard.|first=Geissler|url=http://worldcat.org/oclc/45816974|title=Hitler und die Biowaffen|date=1998|publisher=Lit Verlag|isbn=3-8258-4077-8|oclc=45816974}}</ref>
* ''Krieg mit Pest und Milzbrand: Die Geschichte der biologischen Waffen und das Versagen der Geheimdienste.'' Berlin 2002
